content.text: Role in HD:

antipsychotics may partly suppress chorea & agitation - an alt first-line tx w depression; dose = ↑ until intolerable SE (ex, lethargy · parkinsonism) or Sx controlled. clozapine: freq WBC counts (agranulocytosis risk)
Risperidone (Risperdal) boxed warning:
Boxed: elderly pts w dementia-related psychosis on antipsychotics @ ↑ risk of death - RISPERDAL ⍉approved for dementia-related psychosis
Risperidone (Risperdal) cerebrovascular risk in elderly dementia:
Cerebrovascular rxns (CVA · TIA), incl fatalities, in elderly pts w dementia-related psychosis
Risperidone (Risperdal) key warnings and precautions:

NMS: if sus, STAT d/c RISPERDAL & provide Sxtomatic tx & monitoring. Tardive dyskinesia: potentially irreversible involuntary dyskinetic mvts - consider discontinuation if signs appear. Met chgs (hyperglycemia · dyslipidemia · body wt gain) may ↑ cardiovasc/cerebrovascular risk. At-risk pts: FBG testing @ the beginning of & periodically during tx. Elevates PRL levels - elevation persists during chronic administration. Consider monitoring orthostatic vital signs in pts for whom this = of concern. Leukopenia/neutropenia: pts w Hx of clinically sig ↓WBC — monitor CBC frequently during first few mo - d/c if clinically sig decline. May impair judgment · thinking or motor skills — caution w operating hazardous machinery incl automobiles
Risperidone (Risperdal) CI and interactions:

CI: known hypersensitivity to risperidone · paliperidone or excipients. CYP2D6 inhibitors (fluoxetine · paroxetine) ↑ risperidone levels — reduce initial dose - do ⍉exceed 8 mg/day. Enzyme inducers (carbamazepine) ↓ risperidone levels — ↑ dose up to double the usual dose - titrate slowly. May antagonize the effects of levodopa & DA agonists
Olanzapine (Zyprexa) boxed warning:
Boxed: elderly pts w dementia-related psychosis on antipsychotics @ ↑ risk of death - ZYPREXA ⍉approved for dementia-related psychosis
Olanzapine (Zyprexa) elderly dementia risk:
Cerebrovascular adverse events (CVA · TIA), incl fatalities, in elderly pts w dementia-related psychosis
Olanzapine (Zyprexa) key warnings and precautions:

NMS: mgnt w immediate discontinuation & close monitoring. DRESS reported w olanzapine (rash/exfoliative derm · eosinophilia · fever · lymphadenopathy w hepatitis · nephritis · pneumonitis · myocarditis · pericarditis) - sometimes fatal — d/c if sus. Met chgs incl hyperglycemia · dyslipidemia · wt gain may be assoc w ↑ cardiovasc/cerebrovascular risk. Monitor FBG & lipid profile @ the beginning of & periodically during tx. Tardive dyskinesia: potentially irreversible involuntary dyskinetic mvts - consider discontinuing if signs appear. May induce orthostatic hypotension w dizziness · tachy · brady & in some pts syncope, esp during initial dose titration. ⍉ concomitant IM olanzapine & parenteral benzodiazepine — potential for excessive sedation & cardiorespiratory depression. Leukopenia/neutropenia/agranulocytosis: pts w Hx of clinically sig ↓WBC — monitor CBC frequently during first few mo - d/c if clinically sig decline. Elevates PRL levels, & the elevation persists during chronic administration. Use w caution w other anticholinergic drugs & in pts w urinary retention · prostatic hypertrophy · constipation · paralytic ileus
Olanzapine (Zyprexa) interactions:
Diazepam & alcohol may potentiate orthostatic hypotension - carbamazepine ↑ olanzapine clearance - fluvoxamine may ↑ olanzapine levels
Clozapine (Clozaril) boxed warning:
Boxed: severe neutropenia w ↑ risk of serious & potentially fatal infect
Clozapine (Clozaril) ANC monitoring:
Obtain baseline ANC b4 initiation - ⍉recommended if baseline ANC <1500/μL - monitor ANC regularly throughout tx. Benign Ethnic Neutropenia: initiation ⍉recommended if ANC <1000/μL
Clozapine (Clozaril) cardiovasc warnings:

Orthostatic hypotension · brady · syncope · ♡ arrest — risk highest during initial titration, esp w rapid escalation - can occur w first dose, @ doses as ↓as 12.5 mg/day, or on restart after even brief interruption - start 12.5 mg QD or BID, titrate slowly, use divided doses. Fatal myocarditis/cardiomyopathy: d/c & obtain ♡ eval on sus - generally do ⍉rechallenge. Myocarditis/pericarditis most frequently w.in first 2 mo - cardiomyopathy Sx USU after 8 wks
Clozapine (Clozaril) sz, dementia mortality, GI and QT:

Sz are dose-related - initiate ↓dose (12.5 mg), titrate slowly, use divided dosing. Elderly pts w dementia-related psychosis on antipsychotics @ ↑ risk of death - CLOZARIL ⍉approved for dementia-related psychosis. GI hypomotility: if constipation identified, monitor closely & tx promptly w laxatives - consider prophylactic laxatives in high-risk pts. D/c CLOZARIL if QTc exceeds 500 msec
Clozapine (Clozaril) NMS, interactions, OD:

NMS: STAT d/c & monitor closely. Reduce CLOZARIL dose to one-third w strong CYP1A2 inhibitors (fluvoxamine · cipro · enoxacin). OD: sedation · delirium · coma · tachy · hypotension · resp depression/failure · hypersalivation - fatal overdoses generally above 2500 mg. ⍉specific antidote - establish/maintain airway, ensure oxygenation & ventilation, monitor ♡ status & vital signs
